payload.claim: Criterion 2/3 requires the second-parent refusal reason to name the stack base and the other (losing) parent in their correct roles (the stack base as 'already this batch's stack base', the other as the one to merge or defer). `test_a_stack_order_stacks_on_one_earlier_pull_request_and_refuses_a_spec_naming_another` only asserts both ids and the two fixed remedy phrases are present as substrings in the reason, never which name fills which role. Swapping the call's two positional arguments (`_second_stack_base_reason(dep, stack_base_id)` instead of `(stack_base_id, dep)`) flips the sentence's meaning — it would claim the actual stack base is 'outside the stack order' and the actually-losing parent is 'already this batch's stack base' — while every current assertion (`"TB-A1" in depb1_reason`, `"TB-B1" in depb1_reason`, `"merge it first"`, `"run the spec in a later stack batch"`) still passes.
